record.body:
## Description

R8: The text `ssh-keygen` appears under `orchestra/tuner/` in only one Python module.
R9: `orchestra.tuner.human_claim.verify_claim_signature` returns true for a valid signature.
R10: Amendment signature verification returns true for a valid signature.
R11: Attestation verification returns true for a valid signature.

## Approach

Add `orchestra.tuner.sign` as the only tuner module that starts `ssh-keygen`. It signs and verifies from a namespace and payload bytes. `amendment`, `attestation`, and `human_claim` call it and keep their canonical payload text. Do not import conductor from tuner.
record.subject: tuner-sign
